classification.difficultyReason: Part a needs the decay factor 0.82, setting up an exponential inequality and solving it with logarithms. Part b needs r from the 1st and 3rd readings (choosing the decreasing root), then the n-1 index shift and a log inequality with base below 1. That is several linked decisions with the interpretation of 'first fall below'.

content.prompt: Use logarithms to answer each part.

children.label: a
children.prompt: A new car worth $\$38\,000$ loses 18% of its value each year. After how many full years will its value first be less than $\$10\,000$?

answer.worked:
After $n$ years the value is $38000(0.82)^n$.
$$\begin{align*}38000(0.82)^n&<10000\\(0.82)^n&<\frac{10}{38}\\n&>\log_{0.82}\!\left(\frac{10}{38}\right)\\n&>6.73\ldots\end{align*}$$
The first whole number of years is 7.

children.label: b
children.prompt: The daily readings of the water in a dam form a decreasing geometric sequence. The 1st reading is 600 ML and the 3rd reading is 384 ML. On which day does the reading first fall below 50 ML?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}ar^2&=384\\600r^2&=384\\r^2&=0.64\\r&=0.8\end{align*}$$
($r>0$ since the sequence is decreasing.)
$$\begin{align*}600(0.8)^{n-1}&<50\\(0.8)^{n-1}&<\frac1{12}\\n-1&>\log_{0.8}\!\left(\frac1{12}\right)\\n-1&>11.13\ldots\\n&>12.13\ldots\end{align*}$$
The first whole number is $n=13$, so day 13.
